top_headline: العنوان : القاهرة للدواجن (POUL.CA) قرار لجنة القيد بجلستها المنعقدة بتاريخ 28/10/2026اسم الشركة : القاهرة للدواجنكود الترقيم الدولي : EGS02 - معلومات مباشر
llm_summary:
- The Egyptian Stock Exchange has allowed the share price of Cairo Poultry to move down by 35.19% and set a temporary suspension level at 27.09%.
- Today, November 15, 2026, is the last day to receive the cash distribution for Cairo Poultry shares, with a coupon value of 1.89 Egyptian pounds per share.
- Cairo Poultry's consolidated profit for the third quarter was EGP 152 million, according to Reuters.
- Despite a 1.1% increase in revenue to EGP 12.1 billion during the first nine months of 2026, Cairo Poultry's net profit after taxes declined by 39.1% to EGP 1.44 billion.
- The company's consolidated net profit decreased by 39.12% to EGP 1.43 billion during the first nine months of 2026, compared to EGP 2.36 billion in the same period of 2025.
- The General Authority for Financial Supervision has approved the publication of a disclosure report by Cairo Poultry regarding an increase in authorized capital and the addition of new activities to the company's purposes, as part of its plan to expand into activities related to the poultry and food industries.
- These developments may impact the stock's performance and investor sentiment, especially given the significant percentage movements and the decline in profits.
